name: Post-Execution Cleanup & Resource De-provisioning Lifecycle
objectives: Extend SandboxRuntimeService with deprovisioning, resource de-allocation, and wiping
Transition stopped or tripped workspaces into 'deallocated' or 'deprovisioned' states
Implement resource pool reclamation returning RAM/CPU/Disk metrics to the pool
Implement an automated idle lifetime sweeper to clean up orphaned/leaked sandbox instances
Verify regression tests to ensure all circuit breaker and resource caps remain intact
